name: Zupra
tagline: Understand it. Change it. Know what changed.
description: Zupra maps your JavaScript or TypeScript repo on your own machine, so you and your AI agent can understand it, change it, and see exactly what changed.
renameNote: The package is still called canopy-engine. It will be renamed to zupra later; the commands above keep working until then.
privacyLine: Your code stays on your machine. Ask AI and Edit run through your own Claude Code login. We never see your credentials or your code.
scopeLine: JavaScript and TypeScript only. Public beta.
